answers.M8-S1: Bees have a natural instinct that lets them always find their way back to their hive, even from far away.
answers.M8-S2: To show the wind blew the bees off course, so it took them longer, but they still made it home using instinct.
answers.M8-S3: That they were just doing their normal job of collecting pollen, because bees always gather pollen to bring back to the hive.
answers.M8-S4: So he could tell which bees were his when they got back to the nest and count how many returned.
answers.M8-S5: He thought the bees would get lost and not come back, but then he was surprised and happy that some made it home.
answers.M8-S6: It goes in time order, telling the steps of the experiment from catching the bees to them coming home.
answers.M8-S7: To show how fast bees can fly, since bees are really quick fliers and can go long distances easily.
answers.M8-S8: To show that catching and marking bees is hard and that he got stung, because bees sting when you grab them.
answers.M8-S9: That they didn't need to see the land, because bees find home with instinct or the sun, not by looking around.
